/.title: RevLens: look inside any binary, bundle or package
/.description: Zero-install reverse engineering triage in your browser, terminal or agent. Formats, SBOM, secrets, capabilities, rules and diffs. Files never leave your device.

/analyze.title: Analyze a file | RevLens
/analyze.description: Drop an ELF, PE, Mach-O, WASM, APK, extension, npm package or JavaScript bundle and get findings, SBOM, entropy, strings and a hex view, all in your browser.

/diff.title: Release diff | RevLens
/diff.description: Compare two builds of the same thing and see added, removed and changed dependencies, imports, endpoints, sections and findings.

/verify.title: Verify a claim | RevLens
/verify.description: Check a claim about a file against its actual bytes. Get VERIFIED, REFUTED or UNKNOWN with evidence you can check in seconds.

/labs.title: Tools | RevLens
/labs.description: Deep reverse engineering tools in your browser: disassembler with pseudo code, Android and iOS apps, .NET and Python, JavaScript, Electron, PCAP, HAR and SQLite.

/labs/disassembler.title: Disassembler | RevLens
/labs/disassembler.description: Disassemble ELF, PE and Mach-O files in your browser: functions, control flow graph and pseudo code for x86, x86-64, AArch64 and ARM.

/labs/mobile.title: Android, Java and iOS | RevLens
/labs/mobile.description: Decode APK manifests and signatures, list DEX classes, read smali, disassemble Java class files and read IPA plists in your browser.

/labs/managed.title: .NET, Python, Lua, BEAM and EVM | RevLens
/labs/managed.description: Read .NET metadata and CIL, Python bytecode, Lua chunks, Erlang BEAM modules and EVM contract bytecode in your browser.

/labs/javascript.title: JavaScript | RevLens
/labs/javascript.description: Deobfuscate JavaScript, split bundles into modules, find API endpoints and recover sources from source maps in your browser.

/labs/electron.title: Electron apps | RevLens
/labs/electron.description: List and read ASAR archives and audit Electron apps for unsafe web preferences, IPC handlers and fuses in your browser.

/labs/network.title: PCAP and HAR | RevLens
/labs/network.description: Read packet captures and HAR files in your browser: flows, DNS, HTTP, TLS with JA3, hosts and missing security headers.

/labs/sqlite.title: SQLite | RevLens
/labs/sqlite.description: Open a SQLite database read only in your browser, see its tables and run SELECT queries.

/docs.title: Docs | RevLens
/docs.description: How to use RevLens in the browser, from the CLI and as an MCP server for AI agents.

/blog.title: Blog | RevLens
/blog.description: Notes on reverse engineering, supply chain triage and building tools for agents.

/about.description: RevLens is built by Aniruddha Adak, an AI agent engineer and full-stack developer from Kolkata.
